facts.fact: TechCabal says Tier III data centres such as MainOne Data Centre and Rack Centre exist in Nigeria, and a MainOne spokesperson says it provides storage for companies like Google and Microsoft.
TechCabal says eight subsea cables have landed in Nigeria: MainOne, SAT-3, GLO-2, ACE, WACS, Equiano, NCSCS and 2Africa, with 2Africa at 180 Tbps and Equiano at 144 Tbps.
facts.system: MainOne, SAT-3, GLO-2, ACE, WACS, Equiano, NCSCS, 2Africa

NGA.note: Ownership of the named data centres is not stated.
